purpose: Post-hoc diagnostics, not model selection or a new confirmatory test

monetary.delete: One stress event at a time; all other event rows retained
monetary.outcome: D+1 through D+h cumulative log return, percent
monetary.covariance: Baseline HAC5 with finite correction; on deletion, eligible event-row sequence is compressed, so deletion p-values are descriptive
monetary.multiplicity: BH over 60 stress differences within each deletion scenario separately; not across selected significant horizons
monetary.support_flag: Fewer than 10 stress events is sparse support; threshold is descriptive, not a validity theorem
monetary.overlap: Shared outcome dates and connected components are descriptive, not effective sample size

joint_var.fits: Exact six frozen reduced-form fits, crypto_first order, frozen lag and response dates
joint_var.acf_cross_correlation: Lags 1 through 40, Pearson correlations of aligned residual vectors; no individual significance tests
joint_var.arch_ddof: Number of regressors per equation, including intercept
joint_var.multiplicity: BH over all 60 ARCH LM tests; BH over all 18 system whiteness tests separately
joint_var.limitation: ARCH is conditional on the fitted mean; HAC or variance modeling does not repair residual serial correlation

prospective.capture: New immutable public-source response bytes with local retrieval UTC, SHA256 and HTTP metadata
prospective.forecast_origin: Full UTC day, next 24 hours only, strictly before outcome
prospective.availability: Actual local retrieval is an upper bound on first availability, not provider-certified historical publication time
prospective.no_silent_change: Do not backdate retrieval, substitute stale feature dates or relax frozen feature timing
prospective.evaluation: No future performance claim before actual eligible predictions and observed labels
